# Clavis 3.7.6

## ✨ New home: clavisenc.com

- Clavis's website is now **https://clavisenc.com**. Links inside the app go there: pricing, release notes and help. Old links keep working and lead to the new address.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now).
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
